AiTestingDefinition.name: Ambika_FAQ_tests_1c_Parking

inputs.utterance: Where can I park at Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin, and do they have valet?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Post Oak Smokehouse has a free private surface parking lot directly behind the restaurant (entered from South Lamar Blvd) with 45 spaces, plus free street parking on Barton Springs Rd after 6:00 PM. They do not offer valet parking.

inputs.utterance: Does Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin have outdoor patio seating and wheelchair access?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Yes, Post Oak Smokehouse has a shaded outdoor live-oak beer garden patio with misting fans in summer and heaters in winter, as well as step-free wheelchair ramp access at both entrances and ADA-compliant restrooms.
